claims: BIGBANG announced a 20th-anniversary world tour starting in August 2026.
G-Dragon revealed the 20th-anniversary world tour announcement at Coachella Weekend 2 on April 19-20, 2026.
The 2026 world tour was confirmed by G-Dragon during BIGBANG's 60-minute set at the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival.
BIGBANG's 2026 world tour will commence in August 2026.
BIGBANG's 2026 world tour marks the group's 20th debut anniversary.
BIGBANG's 2026 world tour features G-Dragon, Taeyang, and Daesung.
BIGBANG performed at Coachella on April 12, 2026.
BIGBANG performed at Coachella on April 19, 2026.
BIGBANG's Coachella 2026 performances mark their first group performance in nearly a decade.
BIGBANG's Coachella set included "BANG BANG BANG".
BIGBANG's 2026 world tour marks their first full-group activity since 2017.
